title: LogoTool provisional logo asset
description: PROVISIONAL draft (schemaVersion 0.1.0-provisional). Logo artwork record with portable asset references. Draft status: subject to the Phase 1 Odoo-discovery exit gate; do not treat as final. Synthetic fixture data only; originals are preserved and no binary round-trip is claimed.

schemaVersion.description: Provisional schema version literal. Any other or missing value must be rejected with a version error.

role.description: Logo-level role hint; per-asset roles stay on assets[]. A reference visual alone is never production artwork.

uri.description: Relative in-package path (portable; never absolute or remote).

sha256Hex.description: Optional lowercase SHA-256 hex of the referenced bytes.

description.description: Optional note, e.g. marking a reference-only external pointer as unresolved.

assetRef.description: Portable asset reference. No binary round-trip claims.
